public_rationale: The claim describes a multiyear future burden without a final deadline. Alphabet's acknowledgment of depreciation and Microsoft's recent earnings results do not establish or disprove that burden. No event meets the early-resolution rule. The unspecified accounting basis also prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment under the supplied rules.
limitations: The available evidence covers individual companies and short periods.
Depreciation can rise while earnings also grow.
The severity and accounting basis require clarification before definitive grading.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Hyperscalers will face brutal depreciation charges or write-offs for years regardless of revenue.
conditions: whether capacity turns into revenue or not

statement.excerpt: At the very least, hyperscalers are going to be burdened with brutal depreciation charges or onerous write-offs for years to come, whether their capacity turns into revenue or not.

from_speaker: brutal depreciation charges or onerous write-offs
whether their capacity turns into revenue or not
our_interpretation: The plain reading is a severe and persistent earnings burden from AI infrastructure depreciation or impairment across major hyperscalers.
Hyperscalers is read to include Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle; the speaker supplies no company list.
Years to come requires a multiyear pattern but supplies no final deadline.
Whether capacity produces revenue is an unconditional assertion, not an antecedent that must occur before assessment.
Ordinary depreciation, or an increase in its dollar amount alone, does not establish the claimed severity.
The sentence supplies no accounting basis, currency or numerical threshold. Accounting basis remains unknown, which bars a supported or contradicted money assessment under the stated rules.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable multiyear financial statements show depreciation or AI infrastructure impairments imposing a severe, persistent burden relative to earnings across major hyperscalers, under a clarified accounting basis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Under a clarified accounting basis and assessment period, representative multiyear results show depreciation and impairments remaining manageable relative to earnings, without the claimed severe burden. A single profitable quarter cannot settle the forecast.

evidence.explanation: Alphabet acknowledges depreciation affecting its businesses. This predates the forecast and does not establish a severe multiyear burden across hyperscalers.

Microsoft reports stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings, providing countervailing context to an inference of an already severe earnings burden. Earnings performance is a different metric and cannot settle the depreciation forecast.
